INSTALL_DIR:
|$HOME/farm-surveillance-v2|g" gc-stale-tmp.plist > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.farmsurveillance.gc-stale-tmp.plist plutil -lint ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.farmsurveillance.gc-stale-tmp.plist launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.farmsurveillance.gc-stale-tmp.plist (launchd does not expand ~ or env vars in plists — sed is required) --!>
Label com.farmsurveillance.gc-stale-tmp ProgramArguments
/.venv/bin/python3.11 /scripts/gc_stale_tmp.py
RunAtLoad
StartInterval 86400 StandardErrorPath /logs/gc-stale-tmp.log StandardOutPath /logs/gc-stale-tmp.log EnvironmentVariables
FARMSURV_GC_TMP_TTL_H 72
